name: Nash U Leadership Internship
city: New York City (all five boroughs) and Newark, NJ
what_you_do: A senior-year internship. You build resume, interview and money skills. You help with Sadie Nash community organizing. You plan a social justice project for your community.
who_can_apply: High school seniors who are women or gender-expansive youth of color and live in New York City or Newark. No academic rules.
pay_detail: Eligible for a $400 stipend at the end of the internship.
duration: Saturdays 10 a.m. to 12 noon, November 2026 to May 2027, plus some events.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the link on the Nash U page. Questions: Charlie Ambrose, charlie@sadienash.org (listed on the page).
notes: The apply page says you must identify as a woman or gender-expansive person of color. You must commit for the full internship.
